board.name: Company Board — General Billboard
board.note: Controlled by the Chief Executive Officer. Access and control of this billboard belong to the Chief Executive Officer by office. Nothing posts to this billboard except at the CEO's direction; Jarvis operates the feed on the CEO's word and keeps the posting record. This is the general Company Board — announcements, study and compilation work, and program news. The Emergency Billboard (assets/emergency-billboard.json) is a separate board: emergencies only, under the same CEO access rule, and it takes visual precedence.

notices.body: California housing law (Ellis Act, Gov. Code §§ 7060–7060.7) and fair-housing law studied and compiled into the company Legal Department standard. Law resources built for the Housing, Peer Support, and Justice Support programs — now in the Portal Housing Law library for all staff.
notices.headline: Legal Study & Compilation — California Housing Law

notices.body: The Portal now carries a Housing Law library: California housing and fair-housing law, compiled by the company Legal Department as a working reference for every program — Housing, Peer Support, Justice Support, and the whole team. Reference information only — not legal advice.
notices.headline: Portal Housing Law Library — Open for All Staff
